data.title: 山田杏奈 · 白裙时装秀的谢幕
data.description: 白裙主题的时装秀来到尾声，杏奈穿着带长裙摆的白色礼服，手捧玫瑰走到T台尽头。头纱和马尾在追光里轻轻晃动，她听见台下熟悉的加油声，便停稳脚步，把练习了很久的谢幕笑容送向那个方向，眼睛里带着完成演出的激动。
data.location: 时尚T台尽头白玫瑰圣坛前
data.action: 在白裙时装秀T台尽头站稳，双手捧白玫瑰，听见加油声后微笑谢幕。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.promptProse: At the end of the white-dress fashion show, Anna Yamada reaches the runway tip and stands securely with roses in both hands. Her white mermaid gown, long veil and high black ponytail move lightly as she directs her practiced closing smile toward a familiar voice in the audience. The medium view includes the runway edge and spectators beyond. White spotlights illuminate veil folds and bouquet petals, with her centered shadow falling along the platform.
